trade_count_definition: Executed ETF buy/sell orders; all initial purchases excluded; assigned by execution date
notes:
All values are USD. Each period is rebased to 100,000; holdings continue.
Annual return is geometric CAGR using 252 sessions per year.
Sharpe uses daily BIL excess returns and their sample standard deviation.
Volatility uses sample standard deviation of net portfolio returns.
Drawdown includes the reporting period's initial value.
Number of trades = individual executed ETF buys/sells, including BIL, by execution date.
Displayed counts exclude initial purchases for all portfolios; their costs remain included.
One portfolio rebalance may contain several ETF trades; see trading_activity.csv.
The fixed 3-percentage-point band applies to all ETFs in M1-M4 and all periods.
Benchmarks: initially equal-weighted 12 ETFs and SPY only; buy once, then no rebalancing.
Benchmark weights and holdings continue across periods; reporting rebasing does not reset them.
Benchmark trade counts are zero after excluding their initial 12 and 1 purchases.
Testing has only 17 observations with the supplied snapshot; annualised metrics are unstable.
This run has no parameter search or use of evaluation results in trading.
Prior inspection of October remains a research limitation.
Assumptions: fixed ETF universe; adjusted distributions; fractional long-only holdings;
no leverage or tax; full fills at next close; 5 bps on buys and sells; no final liquidation.
